title: Posting COMMENT messages to Help Desk threads fails from 2026-09-23
summary: HubSpot is replacing Help Desk thread comments with notes. Since 2026-09-23, POST .../threads/{threadId}/messages with "type": "COMMENT" on a thread whose inbox type is HELP_DESK returns a VALIDATION_ERROR (subCategory ConversationsApiError.HELPDESK_INBOX_CANNOT_PUBLISH). Comments on conversations-inbox threads still work.
migrationNote: Before posting a COMMENT, check the thread's inbox (thread originalChannelAccountId -> channel account inboxId -> inbox type) or catch HELPDESK_INBOX_CANNOT_PUBLISH; for HELP_DESK inboxes create a note with the CRM Notes API and associate it with the thread's associatedTicketId, and read the ticket's notes instead of thread comments.
